before.exam_tip_html: In the AQA writing exam, examiners reward variety of language. Do not repeat the same opinion phrase — use creo que, en mi opinión, a mi modo de ver, and me parece que across your response. When describing friends, always give a reason after your opinion to develop your answer: Mi amiga es simpática porque siempre me escucha (My friend is nice because she always listens to me). Reasons linked with porque, ya que, or dado que show the examiner you can justify your views.
